name: silver-sequin-red-carpet-bts
image_vibe: soft glamour, shimmer, playful, candid, editorial

prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic four-panel fashion collage showing one original adult woman preparing for a high-fashion event, with soft glamour, shimmering silver fabric, candid behind-the-scenes energy and cinematic editorial polish.
prompt.main_subject: One original adult woman with chestnut-brown hair and honey-blonde balayage highlights, neutral pink lipstick, defined eyelashes and a consistent original identity across all panels. She wears a tulle-base dress with heavy silver and iridescent sequin embroidery in organic feather or leaf-like swirling motifs, white-gold or platinum jewelry with a multi-layered coiled bracelet, and a refined red-carpet styling. Do not reproduce Ana de Armas or any other public figure.
prompt.composition_elements: Arrange four equal panels. Top-left: close-up mirror selfie with direct camera engagement, clear sequin texture, neutral pink lipstick and defined lashes, white iPhone with MagSafe case. Top-right: behind-the-scenes side profile while a makeup artist applies lipstick, photographer visible in background and natural window light. Bottom-left: medium over-the-shoulder smile with playful candid mood, showing the dress's deep cowl-back design and delicate crossover straps. Bottom-right: full-length side view on an outdoor balcony overlooking a city with palm trees and buildings during golden hour. Keep identity, dress, hair and jewelry consistent across panels.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Use natural window light for the makeup touch-up panel, soft flattering mirror light for the selfie, balanced editorial light for the medium shot and warm golden-hour light for the balcony. Preserve silver and lavender-mist dominant colors with saddle-brown and light-pink accents, realistic sequin sparkle and candid red-carpet preparation atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic four-panel collage, consistent adult identity and wardrobe, realistic tulle, sequins, jewelry, hair, skin, phone and city texture, clean panel alignment, high-fashion editorial finish, no text, logo or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Photorealistic four-panel red-carpet fashion collage of one original adult woman with chestnut-brown hair and honey-blonde balayage, neutral pink lipstick and defined lashes, wearing a tulle-base dress covered in silver and iridescent sequin feather/leaf motifs with white-gold or platinum coiled bracelet. Top-left close-up mirror selfie with white iPhone and clear sequin detail; top-right BTS side profile while lipstick is applied with photographer behind and natural window light; bottom-left medium over-shoulder playful smile showing deep cowl back and delicate crossover straps; bottom-right full-length balcony side view overlooking palm trees and city buildings at golden hour. Silver and lavender palette with brown and pink accents, soft glamour shimmer, candid editorial mood, no public-figure likeness.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, sexualized pose, fetish styling, minor, teenage appearance, public-figure likeness, Ana de Armas likeness, inconsistent identity, inconsistent dress, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, malformed hands, broken collage alignment, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, random text, logo, watermark
